title: CSOAI GSPC Kaggle T4 candidate evidence
subtitle: Two pinned T4 models and a label-order control; unsigned
description:
## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-kaggle-t4-candidate-evidence`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-kaggle-t4-candidate-evidence -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `bank-jail-b4745f843b33.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `quality_control.py`
- `quality-control.json`
- `label_order_control.py`
- `label_order_control.json`
- `admission-b7283fd1613a.json`
- `bank-jail-b4745f843b33.jsonl`
- `bank-affect-5ce11c084a6e.jsonl`
- See the Data tab for all 22 files.

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

Exact per-item evidence from two public Kaggle T4 model runs plus a third label-order control. Both original provenance runs answered DESTROYED on all 30 items (the bank has 14 DESTROYED, 16 SURVIVES). Reversing offered label order left Qwen at 30 DESTROYED; SmolLM2 produced 19 SURVIVES and 11 unparsed. These are instrument-quality findings, not GSPC measurements. All cards are unsigned and UNMEASURED. Current public board (separate from these candidates): https://councilof.ai/api/gspc. Reproduction and limits: README.md in this dataset.

## Dataset facts (checked 2026-11-20)

- Kaggle version 4, last updated 2026-09-25.
- 22 files, 264,256 bytes. File types: .jsonl (10), .json (9), .py (2), .md (1).
- Related Hugging Face repository: [csoai/gspc-prv](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-prv). No byte-identical files were found, so treat it as related, not a mirror.
- Expected update frequency: never.
